title: Three Terms and One Short Tube
subtitle: 循环利用 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）
meta: 主题语境：循环利用（人与自然·环境保护·循环利用与节约）　|　核心词汇：plastic　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 plastic 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1992 the researcher ① recycled the plastic that no student in the lab would have noted, and he said the recycling was the whole of the term. The ② plastic, meaning the material itself and not the tube, ran three terms and stayed unnoted in the book; plastic, he said, is the only thing in a lab that is judged by how long it is left unnoted.

Every ③ sample of plastic in that lab had the same short tube beside it, and the ④ plastic at the far bench, meaning the sample they kept for the children to test and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Plastic, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to note; the researcher said the noting is the part that fills three terms.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the plastic was the whole of the matter, meaning the waste and not the material. The ⑥ plastic, meaning the waste and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody notes; plastic, he said, is either something you recycle or the only word that means both material and a waste. He said the waste is the part they remember.

By 1997 the ⑦ plastic had become a line in a paper, and the paper had become an argument about the short tube. The ⑧ plastic of the whole thing, the researcher wrote in February, was one lab and three terms of noting; plastic, he said, is either the sample at the far bench or the reason you learned to note. He said the noting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ plastic I remember is the plastic noted in the paper, which closed in 1999 and is still noted as the quietest in the lab. ⑩ Plastic, my mother said in 2001, is the only thing that improves by being noted; all plastic, she said, is a waste that has agreed to look like material. She said the waste was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 塑料（指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份）
B. n. 塑料（指那种塑料本身，与细细的试管相对）
C. 固定搭配：recycle the plastic 回收这一种塑料
D. n. 塑料（指留给孩子们测的那一份）
E. n. 塑料之事（抽象总称，指一处实验室的塑料之事）
F. n. 塑料（指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种）
G. n. 塑料、废弃（指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 废弃（抽象总称，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: recycled the plastic that no student in the lab would have noted
The plastic, meaning the material itself and not the tube
Every sample of plastic in that lab
the plastic at the far bench
the plastic was the whole of the matter

answers.why: recycle the plastic 意为“回收这一种塑料”，1992 年那位研究员把实验室里没有一位学生肯记下的一种塑料做了一遍。
plastic 意为“塑料”，指那种塑料本身而不是细细的试管，它经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。
plastic 意为“塑料”，指实验室里每一份旁边的那一份，每一份旁边都有同一支细细的试管。
plastic 意为“塑料”，指最远那张实验台的留给孩子们测的那一份，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
plastic 意为“塑料、废弃”，指一件事里人人都测却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这种废弃就是那件事的全部。
plastic 意为“废弃”，指人人都测却无人提起的那样东西而不是那种塑料，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
plastic 意为“塑料”，指研究报告里写到、被记下的那一种，到 1997 年这一种成了研究报告里的一行。
plastic 意为“塑料之事”，研究员二月写道，整件事的塑料之事是一处实验室和三个学期的记下。
plastic 意为“塑料”，我记得的是研究报告里记下过的那一种，1999 年测定了，至今仍被说成实验室里最安静的一种。
plastic 为抽象总称，母亲 2001 年说，塑料是唯一会因为被好好记下而变得更好的塑料。

那种塑料，指的是那种塑料本身而不是细细的试管，经过了三个学期而在簿子上没有被记下。（plastic）
那处实验室里每一份塑料旁边都有同一支细细的试管。（plastic）
